messages:
isabel (People Ops): Heads-up: rolling out a lightweight 'reviewer-swap' flow for managers who need to reassign reviewers after the forms locked. This is for availability/conflict cases only. Read steps + RT if you own rows.

amira (Eng Manager): Okay — what's the window? we had a reviewer go OOO unexpectedly and need to swap.

isabel (People Ops): Window: 48h after forms lock. Conditions: reviewer unavailable (OOO, emergency), clear conflict of interest, or incorrect reviewer assignment. Not for changing reviewer because of rating preference.

trent (HRBP): What's the approval path? do managers self-approve swaps?

isabel (People Ops): Approval path: manager nominates a swap in the tracker (column: swap-request) + reason code. HRBP approves if conflict/COI, otherwise People Ops approves for availability swaps. Simple checklist applied automatically.

amira (Eng Manager): Example entry for the tracker?

isabel (People Ops): Put: "swap-request: replacing Alex with Priya — reviewer OOO (start 2026-06-03)" and set reason_code: "availability". If it's COI, include brief note (e.g., direct mentorship in last 6 months).

ops-bot: Reminder: forms locked 36 hours ago for cycle Q2-2026. Swap window open for 12 more hours. (auto)

dan (Finance): Quick note: if the swap affects calibration group composition and has comp implications, flag 'offer_impact' so finance/comp can review before final sign-off.

isabel (People Ops): Good catch. We'll auto-add an 'impact_review' step when 'offer_impact' is true which pings finance and recruiting.

trent (HRBP): How do we prevent gaming the flow (e.g., swap to a friendly reviewer)?

isabel (People Ops): Controls: (1) limit swaps to 1 per review row, (2) require manager justification in tracker, (3) HRBP/People Ops audit logs all swaps, and (4) chairs see a 'swapped' flag in calibration packets. Repeated swaps by same manager will trigger a manual audit.

amira (Eng Manager): If the swap is approved, does the new reviewer get access to historic comments?

isabel (People Ops): Yes  new reviewer gets read-only access to prior comments and the full review form. We also email the new reviewer with a short summary and a 72h turnaround expectation.

dan (Finance): Can we see a small export of swaps for comp reconciliation?

isabel (People Ops): Sure — transparency export command (for ops):
```
curl -s "https://internal-api.redwood/reviews/swaps?cycle=Q2-2026" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PO_KEY" -o swaps_q2.csv
```

trent (HRBP): Escalation if a swap is disputed by the original reviewer?

isabel (People Ops): If original reviewer disputes, we open a triage: People Ops mediates; if unresolved, escalate to HRBP + Director. Dispute doesn't block calibration but is logged.

amira (Eng Manager): I'll file one swap request now for my team (reviewer had emergency). Thanks for the clear flow.

isabel (People Ops): Thanks  I'll monitor the swaps queue and post a short summary when closed. Please only use this for genuine availability/COI cases. :white_check_mark:
